declarations.documentation:
One persona layer — the unit the caller supplies. @name@ is its store key and the identifier
`refine` targets, @label@ is the `[label]` header its assembled section wears, @cap@ is the hard
character ceiling `refine` enforces, @seed@ is the in-code default body shown until a refinement is
stored, @roles@ is the set of role names that see this layer, and @hard_lines@ is an uneditable prefix
prepended above the refinable body at every assembly.
declarations.name: layer

The facility's one subdirectory under the calling workspace, prefixed to every persona read and
write. The package hard-codes the subdirectory name, never the full location.

declarations.documentation:
Render one stored layer value as text: a plain string as itself, anything else as its JSON — total,
so a malformed stored value degrades rather than throwing into an every-turn assembly.
declarations.name: render_value

declarations.documentation:
The live body of one layer: its stored value once a refinement exists, its in-code @seed@ until
then. The caller must already stand inside the facility workspace, which `assemble` opens once around
the whole read.
declarations.name: live_body

declarations.checkedType: agent(layers: array[layer], role: string) -> string with delete | get | list | set
declarations.documentation:
Assemble one role's persona note: render the `[label]` section of each layer the role sees, in the
given order, and join them with a blank line. Every layer is read fresh from the store under the
facility workspace, so a refinement is live on the very next turn and a compaction can never eat a
persona. A layer the role does not see is skipped, and a role that sees nothing assembles to "".
declarations.name: assemble

declarations.checkedType: agent(layers: array[layer], name: string, text: string) -> string with delete | get | list | set
declarations.documentation:
Refine one layer — the anti-creep write, answering the sentence a model reads. Look @name@ up among
@layers@: an unknown name answers a corrective note listing the layers (never a crash — the name is
model-supplied); a @text@ over the layer's cap is rejected with the cap and the overshoot; a text
within cap overwrites the whole layer body under the facility workspace and confirms. The hard lines
are never stored and never touched, and a whole-key overwrite is last-write-wins, so this takes no
critical section.
declarations.name: refine
